DialogueEN: Why is there a hole here now?
There is indeed something wrong with this place.
DialogueID: Memang ada yang salah dari tempat ini.

DialogueEN: Ugh. Is this really the only way out for me?
DialogueID: Duh. Hanya ini ya satu-satunya jalanku buat keluar?
Kuatkan hatimu, Lara. Yok kita lompat.

DialogueEN: Why is there this pressure again?
Oh nooo, it's starting to get dark outside now.
DialogueID: Duh, sekarang di luar sudah mulai kelihatan gelap.

DialogueEN: What you're looking for isn't here.
DialogueID: Yang kamu cari-cari di sini tuh gak ada.

DialogueEN: Stop denying it. Wake up to reality.
Not focused on listening to the figure who resembled him.
DialogueID: Tidak fokus mendengarkan sosok yang mirip dengan dirinya.

DialogueEN: Elara's legs were trembling, and her heart was pounding.
DialogueID: Kaki Elara bergetar dan jantungnya berdegup kencang.
Secara tidak sengajaa, Elara berjalan mundur perlahan-lahan.

DialogueEN: Until she didn't realize it. Elara fell.
DialogueID: Hingga tanpa ia sadari. Elara terjatuh.
